nodes.odrzucil.text.t: 'Refusal accepted.' The murmur sounds one last time and dies away. The stone goes cold as a gravestone. You're left alone with your questions, but also with the sense that nobody has any power over you.

nodes.powitanie.options.[sluchaj].text.t: Put your hand on a stone and listen.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: Twelve stones stand in a ring, each with one face smooth as a mirror. The murmur you take for voices runs together into a single note, barely audible, like wind in a chimney.

nodes.przyjal.text.t: 'Good. The debt is incurred.' The murmur dies away, and in your head stays a hazy trace of something you have never seen. As if someone had burned a mark inside you that won't come off.

nodes.sluchaj.text.t: The stone is warm as skin. The murmur forms into words that are not words: 'We remember you. We remember what you carry inside you. We can explain it to you, if you agree that we will remember you always.' For a moment you feel that for a yes you'd get an answer to every question, and for a no you'll be left alone with your own.
